title.zh: 生物分类与二歧检索表

clips.send: Class. Mammalia. Classes divide a phylum further. Mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians and bony fish are different classes of chordates.
clips.text: Class. Mammalia. Classes divide a phylum further.. Mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians and bony fish are different classes of chordates.

clips.send: All life. Every living thing starts here: about 2 million named species, and millions more not yet named. Each ring below holds fewer organisms that share more traits.
clips.text: All life. . Every living thing starts here: about 2 million named species, and millions more not yet named.. Each ring below holds fewer organisms that share more traits.

clips.send: Family. Canidae. A family contains closely related genera. Example: the dog family (Canidae) and the cat family (Felidae).
clips.text: Family. Canidae. A family contains closely related genera.. Example: the dog family (Canidae) and the cat family (Felidae).

clips.send: Family. Hominidae. A family contains closely related genera. Example: the dog family (Canidae) and the cat family (Felidae).
clips.text: Family. Hominidae. A family contains closely related genera.. Example: the dog family (Canidae) and the cat family (Felidae).

clips.send: Order. Carnivora. Orders split a class using more specific traits, such as teeth, feet or diet. Carnivores, primates and rodents are orders of mammals.
clips.text: Order. Carnivora. Orders split a class using more specific traits, such as teeth, feet or diet.. Carnivores, primates and rodents are orders of mammals.

clips.send: Genus. Canis. A genus holds very closely related species. The genus is the first word of a scientific name and is always capitalized.
clips.text: Genus. Canis. A genus holds very closely related species.. The genus is the first word of a scientific name and is always capitalized.

clips.send: Kingdom. Animalia. Six kingdoms: Eubacteria, Archaebacteria, Protista, Fungi, Plantae and Animalia. Kingdoms are based on cell type, number of cells and how the organism gets food.
clips.text: Kingdom. Animalia. Six kingdoms: Eubacteria, Archaebacteria, Protista, Fungi, Plantae and Animalia.. Kingdoms are based on cell type, number of cells and how the organism gets food.

clips.send: Order. Primates. Orders split a class using more specific traits, such as teeth, feet or diet. Carnivores, primates and rodents are orders of mammals.
clips.text: Order. Primates. Orders split a class using more specific traits, such as teeth, feet or diet.. Carnivores, primates and rodents are orders of mammals.

clips.send: Phylum. Chordata. A phylum groups organisms with the same basic body plan. Example: Arthropoda (insects, spiders, crabs) all have jointed legs and an exoskeleton.
clips.text: Phylum. Chordata. A phylum groups organisms with the same basic body plan.. Example: Arthropoda (insects, spiders, crabs) all have jointed legs and an exoskeleton.

clips.send: Domain. Eukarya. The broadest level. There are 3 domains: Bacteria, Archaea and Eukarya. Eukarya equals every organism whose cells have a nucleus.
clips.text: Domain. Eukarya. The broadest level. There are 3 domains: Bacteria, Archaea and Eukarya.. Eukarya = every organism whose cells have a nucleus.

clips.send: Species. Homo sapiens. A species is a group of organisms that can breed together and produce fertile offspring. Its scientific name has two words: Genus + species, like Canis lupus.
clips.text: Species. Homo sapiens. A species is a group of organisms that can breed together and produce fertile offspring.. Its scientific name has two words: Genus + species, like Canis lupus.

clips.send: Genus. Homo. A genus holds very closely related species. The genus is the first word of a scientific name and is always capitalized.
clips.text: Genus. Homo. A genus holds very closely related species.. The genus is the first word of a scientific name and is always capitalized.

clips.send: Species. Canis lupus. A species is a group of organisms that can breed together and produce fertile offspring. Its scientific name has two words: Genus + species, like Canis lupus.

clips.send: 属。Canis。属包含亲缘关系非常近的物种。属名是学名的第一个词，首字母总是大写。
clips.text: 属. Canis. 属包含亲缘关系非常近的物种。. 属名是学名的第一个词，首字母总是大写。

clips.send: 域。Eukarya。最大的分类等级，共有 3 个域：细菌域、古菌域和真核生物域。真核生物域 等于 细胞有细胞核的所有生物。
clips.text: 域. Eukarya. 最大的分类等级，共有 3 个域：细菌域、古菌域和真核生物域。. 真核生物域 = 细胞有细胞核的所有生物。

clips.send: 目。Carnivora。目用更具体的特征（如牙齿、足、食性）来划分纲。食肉目、灵长目、啮齿目都是哺乳纲中的目。
clips.text: 目. Carnivora. 目用更具体的特征（如牙齿、足、食性）来划分纲。. 食肉目、灵长目、啮齿目都是哺乳纲中的目。

clips.send: 界。Animalia。六界：真细菌界、古细菌界、原生生物界、真菌界、植物界和动物界。界的划分依据：细胞类型、细胞数量以及获取食物的方式。
clips.text: 界. Animalia. 六界：真细菌界、古细菌界、原生生物界、真菌界、植物界和动物界。. 界的划分依据：细胞类型、细胞数量以及获取食物的方式。

clips.send: 科。Canidae。科包含亲缘关系很近的几个属。例如犬科和猫科。
clips.text: 科. Canidae. 科包含亲缘关系很近的几个属。. 例如犬科和猫科。

clips.send: 纲。Mammalia。纲是对门的进一步划分。哺乳动物、鸟类、爬行动物、两栖动物和硬骨鱼是脊索动物门中的不同纲。
clips.text: 纲. Mammalia. 纲是对门的进一步划分。. 哺乳动物、鸟类、爬行动物、两栖动物和硬骨鱼是脊索动物门中的不同纲。

clips.send: 种。Canis lupus。物种是能够相互交配并产生可育后代的一群生物。它的学名由两个词组成：属名 + 种加词，例如 Canis lupus。
clips.text: 种. Canis lupus. 物种是能够相互交配并产生可育后代的一群生物。. 它的学名由两个词组成：属名 + 种加词，例如 Canis lupus。

clips.send: 门。Chordata。同一个门的生物具有相同的基本身体结构。例如节肢动物门（昆虫、蜘蛛、螃蟹）都有分节的足和外骨骼。
clips.text: 门. Chordata. 同一个门的生物具有相同的基本身体结构。. 例如节肢动物门（昆虫、蜘蛛、螃蟹）都有分节的足和外骨骼。

clips.send: 所有生物。。所有生物都从这里开始：已命名的物种约 200 万种，还有数百万种尚未命名。越往下的圆环，生物越少，共同特征越多。
